---
title: "Lab handbook"
subtitle: "How the Environmental Genomics Laboratory works: rules, equipment and good practice"
---

The lab handbook collects everything that is not a protocol: the rules everyone follows in the lab, the equipment and how to use it, and good-practice guides for data and samples. Protocols are in the [protocol register](../register.qmd).

| Section | What you find there |
|:--|:--|
| [Joining EnGeL](joining.qmd) | What to read and do in your first weeks |
| [Lab rules and safety](EnGeL-GUIDE-LABRULES.qmd) | General rules, cleaning, waste, consumables, freezers, incidents |
| [File and folder management](EnGeL-GUIDE-FILES.qmd) | Naming and organising project files, scripts and the lab notebook |
| [Sample labelling and storage](EnGeL-GUIDE-SAMPLES.qmd) | Sample labels, storage conditions and the sample log |
| [Lab members only](internal.qmd) | Shared folder with logs, registers and internal documents |

**Equipment** has its own section in the menu: the [instrument list](equipment/index.qmd), with the protocols that use each instrument, and a guide for each instrument that needs one (for example the [bench autoclave](equipment/EnGeL-GUIDE-AUTOCLAVE.qmd)).

Guides follow the same rules as the protocols: each has an ID, a version, authors and a version history, and values that still have to be confirmed are marked [TO CONFIRM].
